description: Autonomous skill-selection layer for Thalarch. Use at the start of non-trivial work and again after project discovery when the current host may expose stronger project-local, official platform, Thalarch, or third-party expertise. Shortlists the smallest high-value skill stack based on task fit, project/toolchain compatibility, authority/currentness, tool leverage, evidence needs, redundancy, conflicts, context cost, and actual host availability.
